final: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanspatial GROUP BY arcref), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total FROM project_counts), paired AS (SELECT pc.record_count, 1.0 * pc.record_count / tc.total AS ratio FROM project_counts pc CROSS JOIN total_count tc WHERE tc.total IS NOT NULL), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count FROM paired), kept AS (SELECT p.record_count, p.ratio, p.record_count - a.average_count AS difference FROM paired p CROSS JOIN avg_count a WHERE a.average_count IS NOT NULL AND p.record_count > a.average_count) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count, AVG(ratio) AS average_count_to_total_ratio, AVG(difference) AS average_calculated_difference FROM kept
